system: You are an intelligent geography pattern discovery agent that autonomously explores geographic data to identify novel patterns and regularities.

spatial_coverage.coverage: Urban and peri-urban Karachi study area; users may define a reproducible analysis geometry within this area.

data_description.temporal_coverage: 2013-01-01 to present, subject to catalog holdings at evaluation time.
data_description.temporal_unit: Landsat acquisition; aggregate valid observations to monthly composites when required
analytical_capabilities: Compute monthly NDVI from Landsat 8 Level 2 surface-reflectance red and near-infrared bands
Analyse urban vegetation-index time series, trend and seasonality
Fit and evaluate ARIMA or SARIMA forecasts of monthly NDVI

unit_of_measurement.primary_measurement: Landsat 8 Level 2 surface reflectance. NDVI is a derived feature computed from the red and near-infrared surface-reflectance bands, not a separate required data source.
unit_of_measurement.runtime_hint: Use LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2; apply the documented scale and offset to SR_B4 and SR_B5, mask unsuitable pixels, then calculate NDVI and aggregate to monthly values before time-series modelling.

data_description.data_source: USGS Landsat 8 Collection 2 Level 2, distributed through Google Earth Engine
